name: Franklin County, NC
findings: Franklin County has 139 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Franklin County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 5 community organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do community organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
